method: One Ardulink session per run: reset/run, DMSTATUS reads only during collection, halt once and read RAM, reboot/run again. Period estimated from host first/last DMSTATUS timestamps and completed block count. No serial UART receiver or current meter used.
limits: Host endpoint/debug uncertainty is approximately one block. Debug register reads often return all ones while clocks are stopped; these are not valid chip status samples. Block/window counters and snapshot integrity were validated after wake/halt. UART transfer across sleep and flow sensitivity still require validation.

subsequent_user_power_measurement.source: Reported by user after flashing Standby firmware; meter setup not independently verified.
